mission.outcome: Land HMS Endeavour: hybrid Luikov inverse combining M9 surface-Dirichlet BC (proven best top BC) with M15 asymmetric-tin bottom BC + alpha(T) oven-spring profile. Tests whether stacking the proven-best BC choice with the additional physics layers identified in M11-M16 finally drops main-bake RMSE below 4 deg C. 5 free parameters: L, D, Lu, q_bottom_eff, alpha_ratio.
